description: Issue #145, and the case that proves the two layers do not double-fire: both issues demand a unit test as actively as the firing fixture does, and NEITHER raises anything, because L1 (#147) already derived a conventional test path for the source file each one declared. That is the whole ordering argument of the ADR — 段1 removes the failure without a human, and L3 only speaks about the residue. The detector reads suspected_files AFTER the derived paths are appended; reading it before would fire on every issue L1 just fixed, so a plan whose scope_defaults is non-empty and whose questions are empty is exactly what pins that.
